playerText.title: Sensor Calibration
playerText.situation: The refit sensor-processing stack works, but its fine correlation remains provisional.
playerText.objective: Coordinate Operations and Science through an independent baseline and a sustained live-load validation.
playerText.whyItMatters: Completion restores 10 Cohesion and makes the ship's authored correlation and reconstruction capabilities available when their evidence contracts permit them.
playerText.operationalEffect: Fine identity, provenance, and reconstruction claims require independent corroboration.

authoredIssues.computerHelp: Ask for the accepted calibration evidence, the next available validation milestone, eligible independent references, and the departments needed to pursue it.

playerText.title: Systems Integration
playerText.situation: The refit restored individual systems faster than it proved they can work together under sustained load.
playerText.objective: Authorize controlled isolation, combined-load, and failover work while commanding the risk and coordination around it.
playerText.whyItMatters: Completion restores 15 Cohesion and unlocks the ship's existing authored integration capabilities when their evidence contracts pass.
playerText.operationalEffect: Unsupported full-system shortcuts remain unsafe because one refit fault can cascade across systems.

authoredIssues.computerHelp: Ask for the accepted integration evidence, the next available validation milestone, safe test categories, and affected departments.

templates.title: The Missed Watch

playerText.situation: A crewmember missed or arrived late for an important watch, forcing improvised coverage.
playerText.objective: Establish the cause, respond proportionately, and restore reliable coverage.
playerText.whyItMatters: Reliable coverage prevents a future taxed scene from losing a qualified crewmember or suffering delay.
playerText.operationalEffect: The department carries fragile watch coverage.

templates.computerHelp: Identify the missed watch, current coverage, and who can clarify the cause without guessing it.

completion.guidance: Complete only after command establishes a legitimate cause category and a credible arrangement for the next affected watch.
exclusions: Punishment without cause is not completion.
Personally taking the watch is not a sustainable solution.

narratorLimits: Do not invent misconduct, addiction, romance, family crisis, illness, or deception.

templates.title: New to the Ship

playerText.situation: A recent transfer meets formal requirements but remains outside the team's informal information flow.
playerText.objective: Create a credible route into the team without forcing friendship or public embarrassment.
playerText.whyItMatters: The team loses less time repeating context and gains a reliable working connection.
playerText.operationalEffect: The team repeatedly loses context around the newcomer.

templates.computerHelp: Explain which routines the newcomer misses and suggest low-pressure working connections.

completion.guidance: Complete after the practical exclusion is identified and one consent-respecting connection is established.
exclusions: Ordering friendship is not completion.
A ceremonial welcome without working access is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent prejudice, hazing, trauma, romance, or personality defects.

templates.title: Message From Home

playerText.situation: A crewmember received a message from home and asks for a bounded accommodation while duty still needs coverage.
playerText.objective: Protect the legitimate need and maintain credible duty coverage.
playerText.whyItMatters: The crew sees that command can protect ordinary personal needs without treating them as failures.
playerText.operationalEffect: The department carries distraction and coverage strain.

templates.computerHelp: Provide the duty schedule and coverage categories while protecting the message's contents.

completion.guidance: Complete after a humane command decision and workable coverage plan are accepted.
exclusions: Demanding private details is not required.
Leave without coverage is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent family conflict, depression, a breakup, illness, or crisis.

templates.title: Credit Where It Is Due

playerText.situation: Useful work reached command without the names of the junior people who actually solved the problem.
playerText.objective: Verify the contribution and make recognition accurate and proportionate.
playerText.whyItMatters: Accurate recognition restores willingness to volunteer ideas and strengthens trust across rank lines.
playerText.operationalEffect: The team is less willing to volunteer initiative.

templates.computerHelp: Point to the originating report, eligible witnesses, and recognition channels without deciding credit.

completion.guidance: Complete after authorship is verified and a specific acknowledgment or correction reaches the contributor.
exclusions: Generic praise is insufficient.
An unverified award is not completion.

narratorLimits: Do not invent theft, malice, rivalry, or promotion eligibility.

templates.title: The Handoff Gap

playerText.situation: A recurring status term means different things on either side of a routine handoff.
playerText.objective: Establish one shared meaning and a reliable check-back.
playerText.whyItMatters: Later operational information becomes faster and more dependable.
playerText.operationalEffect: The receiving group must reconfirm routine information.

templates.computerHelp: Display the two formulations and identify representatives who can reconcile them.

completion.guidance: Complete after the ambiguity, shared convention, and one credible use are established.
exclusions: A vague order to communicate better is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent sabotage, incompetence, or catastrophe.

templates.title: Who Owns the Next Step?

playerText.situation: Two departments each reasonably believe the other owns the next step, leaving minor work stalled.
playerText.objective: Assign accountable ownership and a clear handoff without manufacturing blame.
playerText.whyItMatters: The stalled work resumes and stops consuming command attention.
playerText.operationalEffect: Cross-department work remains stalled.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize the workflow and where custody becomes ambiguous.

completion.guidance: Complete after one accountable role, next action, and acceptance signal are established.
exclusions: Doing the work personally is not a durable answer.

narratorLimits: Do not invent negligence, corruption, or obstruction.

templates.title: One Bad Drill Habit

playerText.situation: A trainee repeatedly uses a shortcut that works in easy practice but would fail under pressure.
playerText.objective: Correct the habit through expectation, coaching, and one safe demonstration.
playerText.whyItMatters: The affected team becomes dependable in the trained role under pressure.
playerText.operationalEffect: One known training vulnerability limits the team.

templates.computerHelp: Explain the drill standard, instructors, and safe retest options.

completion.guidance: Complete after the habit, correct standard, and one corrected repetition are accepted.
exclusions: A lecture without practice is insufficient.
Humiliation is not completion.

narratorLimits: Do not invent injury, discipline, or broad incompetence.

templates.title: The Maintenance Window

playerText.situation: Necessary maintenance keeps slipping because another department cannot conveniently release access.
playerText.objective: Choose a safe time and acceptable limitation so the crew can begin the work.
playerText.whyItMatters: The access blocker ends before routine deferral becomes a real capability restriction.
playerText.operationalEffect: Maintenance cannot begin and crews repeatedly renegotiate access.

templates.computerHelp: Provide duration, affected functions, schedule conflicts, and known alternatives.

completion.guidance: Complete after a feasible window, acknowledgments, limits, and actual release of access are accepted.
exclusions: Personally repairing the system is not required.
Scheduling without access is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent catastrophic failure or maintenance results.

templates.title: The Missing Pet

playerText.situation: A crewmember's approved pet escaped into a shared or operational area.
playerText.objective: Organize a proportionate search and return or safely contain the animal.
playerText.whyItMatters: The area returns to work and the player gets a personal way to show their command style.
playerText.operationalEffect: A localized search diverts crew attention.

templates.computerHelp: Give the last-known location and safe routes without claiming to know the animal's location.

completion.guidance: Complete after a bounded plan and safe recovery or containment are accepted.
exclusions: An unrestricted shipwide search is disproportionate.

narratorLimits: Do not injure the pet, create contamination, or mock the owner.

templates.title: Holodeck Double Booking

playerText.situation: Two legitimate groups were promised the same limited recreation period.
playerText.objective: Reach a fair arrangement that treats rest and community as real needs.
playerText.whyItMatters: The conflict ends and access to restorative recreation remains credible.
playerText.operationalEffect: The involved groups cooperate less readily.

templates.computerHelp: Provide reservation history, alternate spaces, and fair allocation options.

completion.guidance: Complete after both groups understand a reasonable arrangement they can follow.
exclusions: Favoring rank or canceling both groups is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent stereotypes, hostility, or policy violations.

templates.title: The Promotion Request

playerText.situation: A crewmember asks for greater responsibility and wants to know what command expects.
playerText.objective: Offer an appropriate opportunity or a concrete development path.
playerText.whyItMatters: Career uncertainty becomes visible progress and future crew capability.
playerText.operationalEffect: The crewmember's initiative and trust in evaluation are reduced.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize public qualifications, opportunities, and relevant policy.

completion.guidance: Complete after a reasoned decision and one specific opportunity, criterion, or review point are communicated.
exclusions: Automatic promotion is not required.
Vague encouragement is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent medals, failures, misconduct, ambition, or resentment.

templates.title: Mentor Mismatch

playerText.situation: A junior crewmember and assigned mentor are meeting but the arrangement is not useful.
playerText.objective: Reset expectations, change the format, or rematch them.
playerText.whyItMatters: The junior's development path resumes and a later readiness gap is less likely.
playerText.operationalEffect: Professional support is ineffective.

templates.computerHelp: Provide the formal goal and scheduling facts without inferring private feelings.

completion.guidance: Complete after the practical mismatch and an acknowledged support arrangement are established.
exclusions: Ordering personal compatibility is not completion.

narratorLimits: Do not invent hostility, bias, attraction, or psychological traits.

templates.title: No Relief on the Roster

playerText.situation: One qualified crewmember repeatedly covers a duty because no reliable relief is arranged.
playerText.objective: Protect immediate coverage while reducing dependence on one person.
playerText.whyItMatters: The ship loses a single-person failure point and gains flexibility under pressure.
playerText.operationalEffect: Absence of one crewmember would delay or limit the duty.

templates.computerHelp: Provide coverage frequency, qualified alternates, and trainable roles.

completion.guidance: Complete after immediate coverage and a concrete dependence-reduction step are accepted.
exclusions: Praise or more overtime is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent burnout, grievance, or unique genius.

templates.title: A Needed Day Off

playerText.situation: A crewmember requests time away after sustained duty, but coverage is uncertain.
playerText.objective: Treat recovery as operational and arrange credible coverage.
playerText.whyItMatters: Near-term readiness improves and sustainable work visibly matters to command.
playerText.operationalEffect: The team carries avoidable fatigue risk and fragile coverage.

templates.computerHelp: Show the schedule and qualified coverage categories without inferring illness.

completion.guidance: Complete after a defined recovery period, coverage, and release into protected time are accepted.
exclusions: Endurance or leave without coverage is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent depression, breakdown, incapacity, or dereliction.

templates.title: The Stale Standing Order

playerText.situation: A standing order from before the refit conflicts with current departmental practice.
playerText.objective: Decide which expectation governs and communicate it.
playerText.whyItMatters: Crew action no longer stalls or changes unpredictably when the rules collide.
playerText.operationalEffect: Contradictory expectations cause hesitation and inconsistent choices.

templates.computerHelp: Present safe summaries, dates, and responsible offices without choosing authority.

completion.guidance: Complete after the governing expectation, scope, and communication path are accepted.
exclusions: Quietly ignoring a rule is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent law, secret orders, or culpability.

templates.title: The Missing Context

playerText.situation: A routine briefing delivered facts but omitted context another team needed.
playerText.objective: Restore the context and establish a lightweight repeatable inclusion.
playerText.whyItMatters: The receiving team acts faster and escalates less routine ambiguity to the player.
playerText.operationalEffect: The receiving group makes slower or less confident decisions.

templates.computerHelp: Compare sent and needed information categories without exposing secrets.

completion.guidance: Complete after the missing context and repeatable inclusion practice are accepted.
exclusions: Dumping all data or vague reminders is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent concealment or consequential failure.

templates.title: The Unfamiliar Evacuation Route

playerText.situation: A work group is uncertain which evacuation route applies after a shipboard change.
playerText.objective: Clarify the route and verify the group can use it.
playerText.whyItMatters: A known emergency vulnerability and avoidable hesitation disappear.
playerText.operationalEffect: The group would hesitate or congest its area during evacuation.

templates.computerHelp: Identify authorized route categories and the responsible safety role.

completion.guidance: Complete after the route and one credible rehearsal are accepted.
exclusions: A notice without comprehension is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent fire, casualty, panic, or unsupported deck geography.

templates.title: The Replicator Queue

playerText.situation: A heavily used service point is overloaded and duty use collides with ordinary crew use.
playerText.objective: Set a fair temporary priority and route around the bottleneck.
playerText.whyItMatters: Predictable access returns and a minor inconvenience does not harden into resentment.
playerText.operationalEffect: One group loses time at a localized service bottleneck.

templates.computerHelp: Provide service status, demand categories, and known alternatives.

completion.guidance: Complete after a clear temporary rule, alternative, and communication are accepted.
exclusions: Permanent rank privilege or unsupported repair promises are insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent starvation, rationing, or class conflict.

templates.title: Quiet Hours

playerText.situation: Crew on different watches are disturbing one another's rest.
playerText.objective: Establish a workable quiet-hours or notification standard.
playerText.whyItMatters: Rest and cooperation improve without requiring a technical repair.
playerText.operationalEffect: The affected watches carry mild fatigue and resentment.

templates.computerHelp: Provide schedule overlap, shared-space rules, and alternatives.

completion.guidance: Complete after a specific acknowledged standard or arrangement is accepted.
exclusions: Total silence or favoring one watch is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent feuds, stereotypes, insomnia, or misconduct.

templates.title: A Place for the Gathering

playerText.situation: A crew group wants a meaningful gathering but space and duty schedules do not align.
playerText.objective: Make a reasonable place for community while protecting operations.
playerText.whyItMatters: The crew gains a real opportunity for connection during a long deployment.
playerText.operationalEffect: A near-term community need remains blocked.

templates.computerHelp: List suitable spaces, capacity categories, and conflicts without defining customs.

completion.guidance: Complete after an appropriate acknowledged arrangement the group can use is accepted.
exclusions: An unsuitable token space is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent religious beliefs, customs, trauma, or compulsory participation.

templates.title: Falling Behind

playerText.situation: A crewmember's performance has declined across several routine reviews.
playerText.objective: Identify the work-relevant cause, establish support, and verify an early result.
playerText.whyItMatters: Dependable performance returns without discarding the crewmember.
playerText.operationalEffect: The department pays extra supervision or coverage cost.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize public performance, workload, training, and support categories without diagnosis.

completion.guidance: Complete after a legitimate cause category, specific support, and reviewed improvement or adjustment are accepted.
exclusions: A speech, punishment without cause, or indefinite removal is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent depression, breakup, family trouble, illness, misconduct, or hidden evaluation.

templates.title: Return to Duty

playerText.situation: Medical cleared a crewmember to return, but duty expectations remain incompatible.
playerText.objective: Establish a respectful compliant return and verify the first duty period.
playerText.whyItMatters: A qualified person returns safely, widening real department capacity.
playerText.operationalEffect: The department underuses the person or risks work outside cleared limits.

templates.computerHelp: State only clearance, functional limits, schedule, and responsible contacts.

completion.guidance: Complete after an authorized functional plan and reviewed first result are accepted.
exclusions: Diagnosis requests, overriding Medical, or unreviewed full duty are insufficient.

narratorLimits: Never invent diagnosis, cause, symptoms, prognosis, treatment, shame, or fear.

templates.title: Sensor Language

playerText.situation: Science and Operations use different confidence language for the same sensor observations.
playerText.objective: Establish shared reporting language and validate it.
playerText.whyItMatters: The player receives faster, clearer sensor advice.
playerText.operationalEffect: Sensor conclusions arrive slowly with ambiguous confidence.

templates.computerHelp: Show current report structures and safe test options without resolving an unknown contact.

completion.guidance: Complete after a shared standard, ownership, and successful controlled comparison are accepted.
exclusions: One-sided adoption or an untested glossary is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent contacts, hardware faults, discoveries, or incompetence.

templates.title: The Blended Watch

playerText.situation: A mixed watch carries incompatible inherited practices that create hesitation.
playerText.objective: Standardize consequential behavior and prove the watch can operate as one team.
playerText.whyItMatters: The watch becomes reliable during unexpected transitions.
playerText.operationalEffect: The watch responds slowly during change.

templates.computerHelp: Compare observed practices and identify the watch leader without stereotypes.

completion.guidance: Complete after the conflict, agreed standard, and coordinated performance are accepted.
exclusions: Declaring one former crew superior or standardizing harmless style is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent prejudice, prior disasters, or universal former-crew habits.

templates.title: Rookies Under Pressure

playerText.situation: A junior team performs correctly in predictable practice but loses coordination when conditions change.
playerText.objective: Observe the failure, coach the response, and verify improvement under a different change.
playerText.whyItMatters: The commander gains another team that can be trusted under pressure.
playerText.operationalEffect: The team cannot be relied upon during rapid change.

templates.computerHelp: Provide qualifications, safety controls, and team-level failure categories.

completion.guidance: Complete after the original failure, targeted change, and improved non-identical retest are accepted.
exclusions: A confidence speech or memorized identical drill is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not create real casualties, humiliation, secret incompetence, or punitive evaluation.

templates.title: Shuttle Turnaround

playerText.situation: Flight Control and maintenance disagree over inspection depth and readiness ownership.
playerText.objective: Set risk, ownership, and readiness criteria, then validate one turnaround.
playerText.whyItMatters: Predictable shuttle availability restores away-team and logistics options.
playerText.operationalEffect: One shuttle's availability cannot be confidently promised.

templates.computerHelp: Provide current steps, schedule impact, and responsible roles without certifying a craft.

completion.guidance: Complete after ownership/readiness rules and one credible ready-or-not result are accepted.
exclusions: Waiving inspection or ordering speed is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent crash risk, damage, negligence, or guaranteed readiness.

templates.title: After the Bad Call

playerText.situation: After a bounded documented mistake, a crewmember hesitates when their role needs timely judgment.
playerText.objective: Debrief fairly, restore supported responsibility, and verify decisive performance.
playerText.whyItMatters: Timely judgment returns and trust is earned through action.
playerText.operationalEffect: The role reacts late or over-escalates routine decisions.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize only the documented event, role, and training options.

completion.guidance: Complete after a fair lesson, authorized opportunity, and reviewed decisive performance are accepted.
exclusions: Demanding confidence or removing all responsibility is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent a serious incident, casualty, trauma, diagnosis, or secret failure.

templates.title: The Informal Leader

playerText.situation: A capable crewmember quietly holds a team together without clear authority or support.
playerText.objective: Preserve useful leadership while clarifying authority, relief, and limits.
playerText.whyItMatters: A fragile personal dependency becomes stable team capacity.
playerText.operationalEffect: Decisions depend on one unsupported person's influence.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize observable workflow and formal roles without inferring ambition.

completion.guidance: Complete after the real responsibility, explicit support, and one use under the clarified structure are accepted.
exclusions: Automatic promotion or praise without support is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent rivalry, resentment, misconduct, or entitlement.

templates.title: Bridge-to-Engineering Lag

playerText.situation: Bridge changes reach Engineering late while engineering limits reach the bridge without decision context.
playerText.objective: Establish and test a two-way escalation path.
playerText.whyItMatters: Bridge choices account for engineering reality before limits become last-minute restrictions.
playerText.operationalEffect: Power or maneuver decisions incur delay or avoidable limitation.

templates.computerHelp: Map message routes and delay categories without inventing limits or orders.

completion.guidance: Complete after a two-way protocol and one understood actionable test are accepted.
exclusions: More reports or a one-direction solution is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent failure, insubordination, or withheld information.

templates.title: Security at Sickbay's Door

playerText.situation: Medical privacy and Security safety duties create incompatible access expectations.
playerText.objective: Establish a narrow protocol for authority, minimum disclosure, access, and escalation.
playerText.whyItMatters: A future sensitive scene can protect care and safety without an arbitrary choice.
playerText.operationalEffect: A routine sensitive event would cause delay, overreach, or under-protection.

templates.computerHelp: Provide general authority and access categories while refusing patient details.

completion.guidance: Complete after a bounded protocol and successful fictionalized scenario test are accepted.
exclusions: Unrestricted access, ignored safety, or real patient details are insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent a patient, diagnosis, offender, threat, investigation, or record.

templates.title: The Evacuation Bottleneck

playerText.situation: A drill shows assigned personnel cannot move through one route without delay and confusion.
playerText.objective: Understand the flow failure, revise the plan, and prove improvement.
playerText.whyItMatters: A known evacuation delay disappears and later emergencies retain safer options.
playerText.operationalEffect: The affected region would evacuate slowly.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize group counts, route categories, and observed delays without fabricating deck plans.

completion.guidance: Complete after the bottleneck, revision, and improved changed retest are accepted.
exclusions: Telling people to move faster or repeating the same drill is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not create casualties, panic, or unsupported geography.

templates.title: Cargo Without an Owner

playerText.situation: Useful supplies move through several departments without accountable custody.
playerText.objective: Trace the gap, assign ownership, and validate one full handoff.
playerText.whyItMatters: Supplies become reliably available instead of existing somewhere but blocking later work.
playerText.operationalEffect: The supply may be delayed, duplicated, or unavailable when requested.

templates.computerHelp: Show authorized records and custody steps without inferring theft.

completion.guidance: Complete after the broken handoff, accountable custody, and successful end-to-end transfer are accepted.
exclusions: A full inventory without ownership change is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent contraband, sabotage, scarcity, danger, or crime.

templates.title: Departments at Cross-Purposes

playerText.situation: Three departments act reasonably under incompatible assumptions, repeatedly breaking one shared workflow.
playerText.objective: Hear every constraint, identify the contradiction, authorize a shared procedure, and validate it.
playerText.whyItMatters: The player no longer has to repeatedly arbitrate the same institutional failure.
playerText.operationalEffect: The workflow loses time and cannot handle unusual demand.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize known workflow conflicts and questions for each department without choosing the tradeoff.

completion.guidance: Complete after all constraints, a shared owned procedure, crew implementation, and operational validation are accepted.
exclusions: Choosing a winner, ordering cooperation, or publishing without use is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent villains, insubordination, hidden agendas, or illegitimate concerns.

templates.title: Damage Control Across the Line

playerText.situation: Engineering, Security, and Medical fallback procedures conflict in one combined emergency.
playerText.objective: Expose the interlock failure safely, revise roles, and prove combined response.
playerText.whyItMatters: The commander gains a coordinated emergency option instead of slower improvisation.
playerText.operationalEffect: Complex casualties force improvised sequencing.

templates.computerHelp: Provide authorized roles and drill controls without revealing hidden vulnerabilities or results.

completion.guidance: Complete after a safe baseline, real interlock, revisions, practice, and improved changed retest are accepted.
exclusions: Tabletop talk, identical repetition, or surprise humiliation is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not create real casualties, punitive surprise, or unsupported geography.

templates.title: Refit Under Load

playerText.situation: A refitted system works alone but remains unproven under realistic linked demand.
playerText.objective: Choose test risk, coordinate consumers, oversee the load, and act on authoritative findings.
playerText.whyItMatters: The refit's specific operating restriction ends and authored high-demand capability may return.
playerText.operationalEffect: The system cannot safely use its highest-demand or automated mode.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize authored evidence, missing validation, consumers, and allowed test categories.

completion.guidance: Complete only through campaign-authorized test evidence and closure of the exact authored gap.
exclusions: Confidence, personal repair, component checks, or unsupported narrated success are insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent technical facts, evidence, faults, capability changes, or results.

templates.title: Three Watches, Three Ships

playerText.situation: Three competent watches use incompatible practices, changing ship behavior at each handoff.
playerText.objective: Preserve harmless strengths, standardize consequential behavior, and prove continuity.
playerText.whyItMatters: The player's options no longer depend unpredictably on which watch is on duty.
playerText.operationalEffect: Readiness and response quality vary at watch boundaries.

templates.computerHelp: Compare accepted practices and suggest standard-versus-flexible distinctions.

completion.guidance: Complete after all watches contribute, train, and pass cross-watch transition validation.
exclusions: Choosing one model watch or validating one watch alone is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not stereotype watches or invent failures and rivalries.

templates.title: The Drill Nobody Trusts

playerText.situation: Crew treat an important drill as theater because it ignores real constraints and changes nothing.
playerText.objective: Hear concerns, design a credible non-punitive exercise, and act on its findings.
playerText.whyItMatters: Training results become meaningful and command follow-through becomes visible.
playerText.operationalEffect: Crews comply with drills but do not transfer lessons into demanding operations.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize safe feedback categories and design safeguards while withholding exercise injects.

completion.guidance: Complete after representative concerns, credible exercise, honest findings, and one implemented improvement are accepted.
exclusions: A harder surprise drill, demanded enthusiasm, or no follow-through is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent trauma, deaths, malicious instructors, or universal cynicism.

templates.title: Power, Sensors, and Priorities

playerText.situation: Several departments need the same scarce power, access, sensor time, or specialist support.
playerText.objective: Map dependencies, choose a transparent sequence, accept a limitation, and oversee completion.
playerText.whyItMatters: Several linked readiness constraints clear and the player chooses the temporary cost.
playerText.operationalEffect: Multiple capabilities remain below routine readiness.

templates.computerHelp: Present authorized dependency categories and tradeoffs without choosing priorities.

completion.guidance: Complete after dependencies, plan, cost, crew time, execution, and readiness confirmation are accepted.
exclusions: Simultaneous grants, personal technical work, or hidden costs are insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent exact figures, failures, component behavior, or completion times.

templates.title: The Shipwide Readiness Cycle

playerText.situation: Several compatible warning signs point to a broad weakness in how the ship prepares and learns.
playerText.objective: Set priorities, delegate a coordinated improvement cycle, validate it, and establish a standard.
playerText.whyItMatters: Four Cohesion segments return and a shipwide readiness limitation ends.
playerText.operationalEffect: Demanding operations expose slower coordination and fewer safe fallback options.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize visible warning signs, departments, scheduling constraints, and planning structures.

completion.guidance: Complete after all department input, declared tradeoffs, delegated work across time, integrated validation, and a lasting standard are accepted.
exclusions: A speech, generic improvement order, premature exercise, or personal technical work is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent shipwide incompetence, hidden failures, serious incidents, panic, or animosity.

templates.title: The Long Watch

playerText.situation: A demanding period has made the ship borrow rest, maintenance, training, and informal support unsustainably.
playerText.objective: Audit the strain, triage operations, protect recovery, and restore a sustainable rhythm.
playerText.whyItMatters: Four Cohesion segments return and fatigue/workload generation is suppressed for two checks.
playerText.operationalEffect: Demanding actions have fewer safe margins and require explicit tradeoffs.

templates.computerHelp: Summarize visible strain, schedules, commitments, and command levers without diagnosis.

completion.guidance: Complete after all reports, explicit triage and cost, owned plan, two time boundaries, adjustment, and sustainability review are accepted.
exclusions: A day-off order, morale speech, instant time passage, or automatic clearing of other issues is insufficient.

narratorLimits: Do not invent burnout diagnoses, breakdowns, family distress, resentment, misconduct, or damage.
